'''Solpear''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Pearpair]] at 6 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "That little pear head is always packed with the strangest worries. Funny, considering Solpear never even had a job before."

Solpear is an early game, blue rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Solpear resembles a pear with duck-like qualities, including a bill and webbed feet. It constantly retains an upset or distressed expression with a single tear in its right eye.  

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "[[NPCs|Dr. Looney]] can't tell if Solpear is a real Tatari or just a figment of his imagination."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Easily overwhelmed by work-induced stress, Solpear is uninterested in fighting and prefers to rest in the shade."

==Strategy==
[[File:Solpear Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Solpear's attack range]]
Good early game tank. Use until better Grass tank is acquired, or in case of heavy Rock Zobo assault.
